name: launchpad-v2
description: Local-first command center for all your projects. One service, many faces.
author: Mikkel
//main: Entry point for the packaged Electron shell. Unpackaged runs name the file directly (`npm run desktop`); a packaged app has only this field to go on.

scripts.//web:scratch: The UI against a second service on a copied database (LAUNCHPAD_DATA_DIR) instead of the live one — the safe way to try a migration. Start that service first: LAUNCHPAD_DATA_DIR=<copy> LAUNCHPAD_PORT=7439 npm run server:once. Its own port is 7422 so it cannot be mistaken for the real dev window on 7421.
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run bake && electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run bake && electron-builder --win
